# cardano.build

> An open, community-curated index of tools, SDKs, languages, infrastructure, people and learning resources for building on Cardano. 427 resources (494 links) in 26 sections. Licence: CC0-1.0. Updated 2026-10-10.

Every resource in the index, as markdown. Each section links back to its place on https://www.cardano.build.
Structured JSON: https://www.cardano.build/data/index.json — short map: https://www.cardano.build/llms.txt
Scope: Anything that directly relates to building on Cardano — not investment, price or trading.

## Where do I start?

First steps, guides and orientation for new Cardano builders. Section id: `start` — https://www.cardano.build/#start

- [Ultimate Cardano Smart Contracts Book](https://a.co/d/04QyMZb2)
- [Cardano fundamentals](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PdjoBLGLnlw): ReddSpark
- [UTxOs, hashes etc. explained](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xARVAXoloY4&t=6): Woodland Pools
- [Native tokens (NFTs & FTs)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6oYio9hNxiM): NerdOut — Andrew Westberg
- [Submitting transactions with cardano-cli](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zs2AWS4xIr0)
- [MeshJS](https://meshjs.dev/): For experienced React / Next.js developers
- [OpShin example](https://github.com/OpShin/opshin-example): For experienced Python developers
- [Zero to mainnet in 5 minutes with Helios](https://youtu.be/z5_1WiVc3aA): Cardano smart contract walkthrough (CryptoJoe101)
- [History of Cardano](https://ctimelines.io): ctimelines.io
- [Wisdom.Courses](https://wisdom.courses)
- [Developer ecosystem surveys](https://github.com/cardano-foundation/state-of-the-developer-ecosystem/tree/main): Cardano Foundation — state of the developer ecosystem

### Guides

- [Getting Started By Mesh](https://meshjs.dev/guides)
- [Cookbook By PGWAD](https://armada-alliance.gitbook.io/cardano-blockchain-developer-cookbook/)

## Hello-world quick starts

The shortest path from zero to a working transaction or validator, per language. Section id: `quickstarts` — https://www.cardano.build/#quickstarts

- [PyCardano](https://github.com/Python-Cardano/pycardano/blob/main/examples/plutus/forty_two/forty_two.py): Submit transactions — Python
- [Pebble](https://pluts.harmoniclabs.tech/): On-chain scripts — TypeScript (formerly plu-ts)
- [Aiken](https://aiken-lang.org/example--hello-world): On-chain scripts — Aiken
- [Helios](https://helios-lang.io/docs/learn/intro): On-chain scripts — Helios
- [OpShin](https://github.com/OpShin/opshin-starter-kit): On-chain scripts — Python
- [Plinth](https://plutus.cardano.intersectmbo.org/docs/): On-chain scripts — Haskell (formerly Plutus Tx)
- [Demeter](https://demeter.run/): Hosted Cardano infrastructure

## Tools, SDKs & languages

Smart contract languages, off-chain SDKs, APIs and hosted infrastructure. Section id: `tools` — https://www.cardano.build/#tools

### Start here

- [Cardano Developer Portal](https://developers.cardano.org/docs/get-started): Cardano Getting Started for Developers

  - [Charles Roadmap Video (2024)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_s4OauGIzNg)
  - [Why Cardano (The Motivation)](https://why.cardano.org/en/introduction/motivation/)
  - [Cardano Forum (Developers)](https://forum.cardano.org/c/developers/29)

- [ABLE Pool cheat sheets](https://able-pool.io/document/): cardano-cli, SanchoNet & Voltaire (CIP-1694)

### On-chain languages & toolchains

- [Aiken](https://aiken-lang.org): Programming language & toolchain for developing smart contracts — tags: aiken, on-chain
  - [Howard Aiken](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Howard_H._Aiken)
  - [Awesome List Code Sharing](https://github.com/aiken-lang/awesome-aiken/tree/main)
  - [Aiken Hello World](https://aiken-lang.org/example--hello-world)
  - [Aiken Step by Step Course (Youtube)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N-JmswJuQRU)
  - [Davy Jones' Locker](https://github.com/ariady-putra/morbid/)
  - [Scarmuega; Hello World using Cardano-cli](https://github.com/scarmuega/aiken-cli-hello-world)
  - [Mint Script with On-Chain Record of Mints](https://github.com/keyan-m/cardano-recorded-mint)
  - [ADAPulse; Overiew](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SpNX3Hun7fM)
  - [ReddSpark; Beginners Guide](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-H5llvQdpRw)
  - [Learn Cardano](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JWmvVJz_X1M)
  - [NerdOut](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9wbQ33uzwsc)
  - [Book.io Token Swap Example Talk-Through](https://www.youtube.com/live/GfsvngmSU0M?feature=share&t=1851)
  - [Transaction Counter Talk-Through by Rhys](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rjj4bs65imA)
  - [Fractionalised NFT Talk-Through by Rhys](https://youtu.be/GiKnbrKHDkg)
  - [Coding in Aiken with --watch command by SundaeSwap Labs](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Um4HQX4gmMs)
- [Pebble](https://pluts.harmoniclabs.tech/): Functional smart contract DSL embedded in TypeScript, formerly plu-ts — tags: typescript, on-chain
  - [Developing a Smart-Contract](https://www.youtube.com/embed/WN4yxa-ISyk)
  - [ReddSpark Step-by-Step](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b6MaSz6NIh8)
  - [ERC20-like — HarmonicLabs plu-ts example repo](https://github.com/HarmonicLabs/erc20-like)
- [Helios](https://helios-lang.io): Helios is a non-Haskell alternative to Plutus that compiles to Plutus-Core — tags: helios, on-chain
  - [Learn Cardano Vid #1](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kfNgze5KEQw)
  - [Learn Cardano Vid #2](https://learncardano.io/podcasts/helios-alternative-smart-contract-language-for-cardano/)
  - [CardanoEasy (CryptoJoe101)](https://youtu.be/z5_1WiVc3aA)
- [OpShin](https://github.com/OpShin): OpShin, a Pythonic programming language for Smart Contracts — tags: python, on-chain
  - [Workshop with Emurgo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S-GgkDsUBpQ)
  - [Learn Cardano](https://youtu.be/JXmTpLZnHjU)
  - [opshinGPT](https://github.com/OpShin/opshinGPT)
  - [& hebi (faster)](https://github.com/ImperatorLang/hebi)
- [Marlowe](https://marlowe.iohk.io): Easily create, verify, and deploy secure smart contracts on Cardano using Ts/Js & Haskell — tags: dsl, typescript, haskell
  - [IOG; Creating Marlowe smart contracts using Blockly](https://youtu.be/EgCqG0hPmwc)
  - [Escrow Contract Walkthrough](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-M67WfWWAF4)
  - [Python Bindings](https://github.com/olofblomqvist/marlowe-py)
  - [Experimental Rust Util Library](https://github.com/OlofBlomqvist/marlowe-rs)
  - [Marlowe Security Guide](https://iohk.io/en/blog/posts/2023/06/27/a-comprehensive-guide-to-marlowes-security-audit-outcomes-built-in-functional-restrictions-and-ledger-security-features/)
  - [Marlowe Runner Demo (Deploy Easily)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B5XcH0j7Y7w)
  - [TypeScript SDK (Beta) Demo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0Qa1CsZUGnw)
  - [TypeScript SDK Repo](https://github.com/input-output-hk/marlowe-ts-sdk)
- [Scalus](https://github.com/nau/scalus): Scalus is a set of libraries to work with Cardano Untyped Plutus Core that works on both JVM and JavaScript — tags: scala, jvm, on-chain
- [aicone](https://github.com/SundaeSwap-finance/aicone): Aiken libraries maintained by SundaeSwap Labs

### Off-chain SDKs & libraries

- [MeshJS](https://meshjs.dev): Build your app with MeshJS, React & Next.js — tags: typescript, react
  - [Learn Cardano](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hzMH2LnzZ90)
  - [An interview with Jingles about MeshJS](https://developers.cardano.org/blog/2023-03-21-march/)
- [PyCardano](https://github.com/Python-Cardano/pycardano): A Cardano library written in Python for creating and signing transactions & works well with OpShin — tags: python
  - [PyCardano Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@pycardano)
- [CardanoSharp](https://cardanosharp.com): Bringing .NET and Cardano Together — A .NET library for Creating/Managing Wallets and Building/Signing Transactions — tags: c#, .net
  - [Sarmaad's blog — Getting started with CardanoSharp](https://sarmaad.com/blog/series/cardano-sharp)
- [Atlas](https://github.com/geniusyield/atlas): Application backend for Plutus smart contracts on Cardano (Haskell) — tags: haskell
  - [Learn Cardano](https://learncardano.io/podcasts/atlas-application-backend-for-cardano-dev/)
- [Cardano Serialization Lib](https://github.com/Emurgo/cardano-serialization-lib): EMURGO serialisation library — tags: rust, wasm
- [cardano-transaction-lib](https://github.com/Plutonomicon/cardano-transaction-lib): PureScript library — tags: purescript
- [kuber](https://github.com/dquadrant/kuber): Haskell library for balancing transactions (dquadrant) — tags: haskell
- [Apollo](https://github.com/Salvionied/apollo): Go library — tags: go
- [adalib](https://github.com/dcSpark/adalib): WalletConnect library (dcSpark)

### APIs, indexers & hosted infrastructure

- [Blockfrost](https://blockfrost.io/): Your gateway (api) to the Cardano ecosystem — tags: api
- [Koios](https://www.koios.rest/): A Decentralised API that provides a consistent query layer for developers to build upon — tags: api
- [Dandelion](https://dandelion.link): Cardano APIs as a Community Service. Free. Forever.
- [Ogmios](https://ogmios.dev): tags: websocket
- [UTxO RPC](https://utxorpc.org): A gRPC interface for UTxO Blockchains — Interact with UTxO-based blockchains using a shared specification with focus on developer experience and performance. — Go, Rust, Python & NodeJS SDKs — tags: grpc
  - [Created by TxPipe](https://txpipe.io)
  - [Uses Dolos, a fine-tuned Cardano Node](https://github.com/txpipe/dolos)
- [Demeter](https://demeter.run): A cloud environment with all the tools for building your dApp — tags: hosted
  - [Founders Interview with Woodland Pool](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zCWtW9hWmdQ)
- [TxPipe](https://txpipe.io/): Open source tools and infrastructure for Cardano developers
  - [Founders Interview with Woodland Pool](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zCWtW9hWmdQ)
  - [Wallet OneBox (wob)](https://github.com/txpipe/wob)
  - [Hollow | Headless Cardano dApps SDK](https://github.com/txpipe/hollow)
- [Blink Labs](https://blinklabs.io): Building open-source technology for the future of decentralized global finance. — gOuroboros, snek tailing tool, tx-submit-api, nview, Docker images ...
- [Strica](https://strica.io/): Open source developer tools for the Cardano ecosystem e.g. Cardanoscan API, Typhon.js
  - [Ouroboros Network JS Github Repo](https://github.com/StricaHQ/ouroboros-network-js)
  - [Typhon JS Wallet Lib Github Repo](https://github.com/StricaHQ/typhonjs)
  - [Typhon JS Examples Repo](https://github.com/StricaHQ/examples-dapp-connector/tree/master)
  - [Cardanoscan API](https://cardanoscan.io/api)
  - [Docs](https://docs.cardanoscan.io)
- [iagon](https://iagon.com/): Decentralised Cloud Storage for Web3.0
  - [iagon App](https://app.iagon.com/)
  - [iagon Docs](https://docs.iagon.com/docs/mainnet-guide/get-started)
  - [API](https://docs.iagon.com/developers/api)
  - [Storage Node Setup & Staking Guide By Cardano With Paul](https://youtu.be/QoJhx6t6VvU)
  - [iagon Launches By Pete & LearnCardano](https://youtu.be/VbOeEw-6gOg)
  - [iagon Founders Interview By Cardano With Paul](https://youtu.be/RURhlMnEV_8)
  - [iagon Founder Interview (What's Next) By Cardano With Paul](https://youtu.be/bSmWm3Fb4rs)

### Integrations, scaffolds & examples

- [IntelliAda (BloxBean)](https://intelliada.bloxbean.com): A tool for developers to interact with Cardano directly from their IDE
- [CardanoPress](https://cardanopress.io/): Connecting WordPress & Cardano — Create engaging & unique Web3 experiences with CardanoPress with no development knowledge
- [Joget DX](https://www.joget.com/cardano-blockchain.html): Create a low-code dApp using the Joget DX
- [Nebula](https://github.com/spacebudz/nebula): A Cardano NFT marketplace contract for individual projects
- [The Plutus Scaffold](https://github.com/mlabs-haskell/the-plutus-scaffold): MLabs scaffold for dApps
- [Atomic Swap Open Protocol](https://github.com/lley154/atomic-swap-open-protocol)
- [AdaStream](https://github.com/nau/adastream): Decentralised file hosting incentivised via Cardano ada payments
- [cnft-delist](https://github.com/elRaulito/cnft-delist): Delist an NFT listed on the deprecated Cardano marketplace
  - [cnft-delist as a hosted service — CNFT Academy](https://cnftacademy.com/hope/)

## Network, scaling & governance

Explorers, Hydra, Mithril, CIP-1694 governance, CIPs and partner chains. Section id: `network` — https://www.cardano.build/#network

### Main chain · settlement layer

- [CIP 19](https://cips.cardano.org/cips/cip19/): Cardano Addresses
- [Pool.pm](https://pool.pm): Stake pool activity
- [Cardanoscan](https://cardanoscan.io): Block explorer & analytics
- [Cexplorer](https://cexplorer.io): Staking, pools & governance
- [ADASTAT.net](https://adastat.net)
- [pooltool.io](https://pooltool.io)
- [CardanoWallets.io](https://cardanowallets.io)
- [CRCI](https://crci.review/crci-scores): Scores
- [Balance Analytics](https://www.balanceanalytics.io): Research & analytics
- [eUTXO.org](https://eutxo.org/): Visual blockchain explorer
- [Cardano Explorer](https://explorer.cardano.org/): Cardano Foundation
- [xerberus.io](https://www.xerberus.io): Risk Ratings
- [cardanotech.io](https://cardanotech.io/wallethistory.php): Wallet Tx History
- [LookerStudio](https://lookerstudio.google.com/u/0/reporting/3136c55b-635e-4f46-8e4b-b8ab54f2d460/page/p_wxcw6g0irc)
- [Side-Chain Tool Kit](https://iohk.io/en/blog/posts/2023/01/12/iog-launches-a-toolkit-for-developing-custom-sidechains-on-cardano/)
- [Mithril](https://github.com/input-output-hk/mithril)
- [IOG](https://www.iog.io/papers/conclave-a-collective-stake-pool-protocol): Conclave a Collective Stake Pool Protocol
- [Cardano](https://developers.cardano.org/docs/developers/curriculum/native-tokens/metadata-registry/): Register Token
- [VeriGlyph](https://github.com/VeriGlyph): Verifiable, on-chain registration certificates (CIP-88)
- [Minswap](https://github.com/minswap/verified-tokens): Verify Tokens
- [The Rosen Bridge](https://medium.com/@rosenbridgeerg/introducing-the-rosen-bridge-a-distributed-network-for-cross-chain-settlement-92b577bd8a27): A Distributed Network for Cross-Chain Settlement
- [Tutorial on Concise Data Definition Language (CDDL) for JSON and CBOR data](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y46dARLUmmI)
- [Milkomeda](https://www.milkomeda.com): L2 Side-chain (Build using Solidity)
- [IOG network diagrams](https://github.com/selfdriven-foundation/about/tree/main/community-projects-we-support/buildingoncardano-dev/diagrams/iog)
- [ADAPulse](https://adapulse.io/zk-tech-unlocking-privacy-on-cardano-scalability-on-ethereum/): Zero-Knowledge (ZK) Tech on Cardano
- [IOG](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2304.06014.pdf): Tiered Mechanisms for Blockchain Transaction Fees
- [KeyPact](https://broclan.io): Multisig wallet, formerly BroClan
- [Strica](https://docs.strica.io/lib/ouroboros-network-js/index.html): Ouroboros network library written in typescript with nodejs streaming module
- [Yaci DevKit](https://github.com/bloxbean/yaci-devkit): A custom Cardano devnet that can be created and destroyed in a matter of seconds
- [Visualisation of a beautiful mega-transaction @ eUTxO.org](https://eutxo.org/transaction/c9cdc33944e7fbbbbff7ea145ac80b139bae918c09509c0c7600dc4b53f19091)
- [Computerphile](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b4b8ktEV4Bg): Hashing Algorithms and Security
- [Midnight Privacy Network](https://midnight.network/)
- [Charles talking about QSig](https://www.youtube.com/live/AwEcqLuT_SA)

- [IOG Research](https://www.iog.io/papers/one-shot-signatures-and-applications-to-hybrid-quantumclassical-authentication): One-shot Signatures and Applications to Hybrid Quantum/Classical Authentication
- [Building Unclonable Cryptography: A Tale of Two No-cloning Paradigms](https://eprint.iacr.org/2023/702)

### CIPs & CPSs of interest

- [What are CIPs?](https://cips.cardano.org/): Cardano Improvement Proposals & full list
- [What are CPSs?](https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIPs): Cardano Problem Statements (listed below the CIPs)
- [CIP-8](https://cips.cardano.org/cips/cip8/): Message Signing (Hardware Wallet)
- [CIP-30](https://cips.cardano.org/cips/cip30/): Cardano dApp-Wallet Web Bridge
- [CIP-31](https://cips.cardano.org/cips/cip31/): Reference Inputs
- [CIP-32](https://cips.cardano.org/cips/cip32/): Inline Datums
- [CIP-33](https://cips.cardano.org/cips/cip33/): Reference Scripts
- [CIP-57](https://cips.cardano.org/cip/CIP-0057): Plutus Contract Blueprint
- [CIP-67 & CIP-68](https://cips.cardano.org/cips/cip68/): Asset name label registry; datum metadata standard (dynamic NFTs)
- [CIP-88](https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIPs/pull/467): Native Asset Policy Registration/Information Certificates
- [VeriGlyph](https://github.com/VeriGlyph): Verifiable, on-chain registration certificates (CIP-88)
- [CIP-93](https://cips.cardano.org/cips/cip93/): Authenticated Web3 HTTP requests
- [CIP-94](https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIP-0094-polls): Polls
- [CIP-95](https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIPs/pull/509): Cardano dApp-Wallet Web Bridge Governance Extension

- [Charles Hoskinson whiteboard video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ja9D0kpksxw)
- [Why we keep on keeping on](https://www.youtube.com/live/VdCNCe1bWfs): Charles Hoskinson
- [Interview with Charles Hoskinson](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CuKhyz280zA): Why decentralisation, the limits of 2nd-gen blockchains & how Cardano fixes them
- [CardanoPick ideas](https://cardanopick.com/ideas/): Looking for something to build?
- [Submission queue (YAML)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/selfdriven-octo/cardano-build/refs/heads/main/data/cardano-build.yaml): New resource links waiting to be added to this index

## About this index

Community-maintained, CC0, open to pull requests. Section id: `about` — https://www.cardano.build/#about

- [selfdriven Foundation](https://selfdriven.foundation): Supports and maintains this index
- [Getting on-chain guide](https://www.selfdriven.support/guides/getting-on-chain/)
- [Why Cardano for on-chain technology](https://selfdriven.fyi/on-chain): selfdriven.fyi
- [Support MeshJS](https://meshjs.dev/about/support-us): We've donated to the MeshJS project — you can too
- [@selfdrivenF](https://x.com/@selfdrivenF): Suggest a resource or ask to be added/removed
- [dsociety.io](https://dsociety.io): Contributing to a decentralised society
- [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/): All content is public domain
- [GitHub repo](https://github.com/selfdriven-octo/cardano-build): selfdriven-octo/cardano-build — PRs welcome
- [Previous upgrade proposals](https://energy.selfdriven.foundation/cardano-catalyst/proposals/previous/)
- [Support this project](https://handle.me/selfdrivenx.cb): $selfdrivenx.cb ada handle
- [Have your say](https://forms.gle/gQgzoJG3sShT8QN56): What should this index become?
